categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Yayi Metal Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of outdoor leisure furniture, focusing on fire pits, gas stoves, outdoor heaters, gazebos, tool sheds, and greenhouses. The company operates a full industry chain and has expanded its product portfolio to include diversified outdoor furniture items. It serves mainly the furniture manufacturing industry with a specialization in metal outdoor furniture.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent innovation with strong R&D capabilities in product design and manufacturing technology. It employs advanced automated production lines, laser scanning, big data collection, and intelligent manufacturing processes to improve production efficiency and product quality. The company also participates in national standards formulation for outdoor gas burners and intelligent control devices, reinforcing its technical leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large international retail chains and online platforms, especially in North America and Europe. The company has stable long-term relationships with major global retailers and leverages e-commerce platforms like Amazon, Wayfair, and TikTok to reach mid-to-high income consumers. Its products are mainly exported to the US, Canada, and European countries, targeting outdoor leisure and hospitality sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Zhejiang Province. It has established subsidiaries and trade companies in Hong Kong, the United States, and Shanghai to support global operations. Its sales focus is on North America and Europe, with plans to expand further into Australia and other emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Yayi Metal Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and direct sales to retailers and consumers. It controls the full production process from raw material procurement to finished product delivery, including online direct sales and ODM partnerships.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to develop innovative, diversified outdoor furniture products with enhanced functionality and aesthetics. It aims to expand production capacity with automation and intelligent manufacturing, deepen e-commerce penetration, and build proprietary brands. Future R&D focuses include new product lines such as outdoor heaters, gazebos, and multifunctional gas fire tables, alongside strengthening global market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of outdoor leisure furniture via direct sales to large retail customers and online platforms. The company also earns income from investment activities and financial asset management. Cross-border e-commerce sales have become a significant growth driver, accounting for over 43% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the niche market of outdoor fire pits and gas stoves with relatively few large-scale competitors possessing strong R&D capabilities. It competes by leveraging product innovation, quality control, and global retail partnerships. Its position is strengthened by participation in national standards and a growing proprietary brand presence on major e-commerce platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 296 million, an 87% increase from the previous year, driven by strong overseas online sales growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 11.17 million, reflecting a decline due to increased depreciation and tax expenses. The company has total assets of about RMB 819 million and equity of RMB 733 million, showing steady growth and ongoing investment in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Yayi Metal Technology offers high-quality, innovative outdoor leisure furniture with diverse design styles catering to various consumer preferences. Its competitive advantages include strong independent R&D, rapid market responsiveness, stable supply chain management, and a growing presence in global e-commerce channels. The company emphasizes product functionality, aesthetic appeal, and compliance with international safety standards to differentiate itself in the global market.
